title: 八號風球
mood: sudden freedom, running laughing into the rain
subject: typhoon signal number eight going up at twenty to five and a whole office building emptying at once
caption: Cantonese drum and bass pop with a radio topline. Chopped breakbeat drums with a ghost-note snare shuffle, held at half-time in the verses and doubling into full drum and bass on the chorus; a rolling sub bass with a filtered Reese layer growling underneath; an airy synth pad and bright piano stabs over the top; rain-like noise swells between sections. Polished and wide, the breaks crisp, pad and piano spread out, the lead vocal clearly forward. Clean mainstream Cantopop male lead holding long notes over the fast breaks, a second male voice rapping the half-time verse. 172 BPM, F# minor. A city let off work early and running into the rain. No trap 808 slides, no glitch effects, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor kick, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Verse]
四點四十 天文台終於肯掛八號
成層寫字樓 一齊鬆咗啖氣
經理話「大家小心」 佢自己行得最快
部電腦都未熄 我已經入咗lift

[Pre-Chorus]
落到地下 個天黑到好似夜晚咁
把遮一開 即刻反咗

[Chorus]
八號風球 全個香港一齊放學
地鐵站人迫人 但個個都笑緊
雨打埋嚟 我冇遮都照跑
跑贏呢陣風 返到屋企先至打風

[Verse]
超市排長龍 公仔麵畀人掃晒
我淨係搶到一包 麻油味出前一丁
群組有人話 今晚打風打邊爐
問邊個屋企最近 全世界望住我

[Chorus]
八號風球 全個香港一齊放學
地鐵站人迫人 但個個都笑緊
雨打埋嚟 我冇遮都照跑
今晚五個人一個煲 喺我屋企等打風

[Outro]
窗口貼好膠紙
個煲已經滾
